summary: Strong, reproducible route-screening reference with explicit leave-one-date-out baselines and conservative multi-part flag thresholds.

artifactRatings.rationale: Flag formulas, counts, and examples are internally consistent and include absolute, relative, and robust-z requirements.
Both requested files and all required observed/expected fields, filters, baselines, thresholds, findings, and limitations are supplied.
Service normalization, minimum samples, date-excluded baselines, robust scale floors, and deterministic replay are well specified.
The CSV has reproducible route keys and rich baseline support; methodology reports reconciled source counts and a checksum.
The report correctly calls flags screening signals, though the one-month baseline and event confounding leave substantial residual uncertainty.

operationalMetrics.notes: Not available from submitted artifacts; do not interpret missing telemetry as zero.

strengths: Avoids target leakage by excluding the candidate date from its baseline.
Requires practical effect thresholds in addition to standardized rarity.
concerns: A one-month history makes weekend expectations especially thin and cannot account for events, weather, or quoted prices.
